subject: Rebooking: POC hands-on session + load test checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morgan <elena@nimbleanalytics.com>; Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbleanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC hands-on: propose kickoff slots and quick checklist

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC. To make the session productive we want to pair on: prompt tuning for your core intents, routing/aliasing rules, and a short load run to validate throughput under your expected payloads. Proposed 90-minute slots:

- Tue Jul 1, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Jul 2, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Mon Jul 6, 09:00–10:30 PT

Agenda (draft attached):
- 10 min intros and success criteria
- 25 min prompt & routing walk-through
- 30 min live tuning and KV/prefix caching demo
- 20 min small-scale load test (we'll run ~5k tokens/min)
- 5 min next steps / rollouts

Prep for the load test: could you share a sample of the average payload (csv) and an estimate of concurrent users / requests per minute? I attached a sample loadtest-sample.csv to show expected format.

If none of those times work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll rebook. I can own calendar invites once you confirm.

Cheers,
Ben

Great, Wed Jul 2 13:00 PT is locked. I've attached the final agenda and a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics). Quick notes before the session:

- We'll provision a test endpoint with the quantization profile we discussed; Marissa will own run-time tuning.
- For the 20-minute load run, we'll aim to mirror your ~120 req/min with a 600-token average; please confirm if you want us to ramp or sustain.
- If you'd like us to include a reranker pipeline for the demo, let us know — that adds ~80ms per request in our baseline.

Marissa & Tessa — FYI, please review the sample payload and confirm VM/kernel profile that we'll request from infra.

See you Wednesday,
Ben

Elena / Samir —

We logged in at 11:00 PT for the Jul 5 slot but didn't see your team. I wanted to check in and propose two quick options:

1) Rebook a condensed 60-minute pairing this week — Tue Jul 7 10:00 PT or Thu Jul 9 14:00 PT
2) If you'd still prefer the longer hands-on, hold Mon Jul 13 09:00 PT and we'll reserve the load-run slot specifically for you

Action items for whichever you pick:
- Confirm ramp vs sustained for the load run (we assume ramp unless told otherwise)
- Share a dial-in user account or API token for the test environment (masked credential is fine)
- Let us know if you want reranker included (yes/no)

I can send calendar invites as soon as you confirm. If it helps, Marissa can do a 15-min quick sync to unblock the kernel/profile choices.

Best,
